_about: What's new: the RELEASED changes a member would notice, newest first, in plain words (src/ui/changelog.js draws them in a drawer from the dashboard). Only what is on main and switched on for people: nothing planned, nothing behind a switch the owner has not thrown, nothing that needs a server step that has not run. `id` is written into the device prefs blob (fms_studio_prefs_v1 `whatsNewSeen`) as the newest entry the reader has opened, so never reuse or rename one; add new entries at the TOP with a fresh id. Dates are the day it reached main. NOTHING IS SHOWN WHILE `entries` IS EMPTY (owner, 1 Nov 2026: the site is launching and nobody has bought anything, so there is nothing to announce): the avatar-menu row, the dashboard button and its New badge all render only when the list holds at least one entry. To post one, add an entry at the TOP and every entry point returns with no other edit. The prefs field `whatsNewSeen` stays.
